// CASE abort_cleanup_nested_loop expect=fire
export async function a1(batches) {
	for (const batch of batches) {
		const results = await Promise.all(batch.map(read));
		if (failed(results)) {
			for (const r of results) {
				await rollback(r);
			}
			throw new Error("failed");
		}
	}
}
// CASE early_exit_nested_loop expect=fire
export async function a2(groups) {
	for (const group of groups) {
		for (const item of group.items) {
			await save(item);
		}
		if (await done(group)) return group;
	}
	return null;
}
// CASE lazy_nested_loop expect=fire
export async function a3(groups) {
	let client;
	for (const group of groups) {
		client ??= await connect();
		for (const item of group) {
			await client.send(item);
		}
	}
}
// CASE single_abort_cleanup expect=pass
export async function a4(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		if (!valid(item)) {
			await rollback(item);
			throw new Error("invalid");
		}
		buffer(item);
	}
}
